product.title: Wagvive Grooming & Shedding Gloves
product.body_html:
Grooming that feels like petting.

Soft rubber tips collect loose fur while your pet experiences what feels like a calming massage, not a grooming session. A gentler entry point for pets who are anxious about brushes, and a great option for senior pets with thinner, more sensitive skin.

  • Reduces shedding without scary brush sounds
  • Doubles as a calming massage tool
  • Adjustable, one-size-fits-most fit
  • Washable and reusable
